title: ilex ambigua var. monticola
intro: Ilex ambigua var. monticola, commonly known as the Monticola Holly, is a plant species within the Ilex genus, characterized by its glossy leaves and red berries. The Monticola Holly is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an immunomodulator and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in immune system regulation and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of Ilex ambigua var. monticola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
